tagline: Europe's leading specialist in shopping centers with exclusive continental European presence
hero_kpi_rationale: EBITDA is the primary operational performance indicator in real estate, reflecting organic growth in rental revenues and cost management, here driven by strong leasing demand and positive reversion.

kpis.name: EBITDA Growth
kpis.explanation: Progression of gross operating surplus, which measures operational profitability.
kpis.description: EBITDA increased 5.4% year-over-year, driven by higher net rental revenues and rigorous cost management.
kpis.signal: Solid EBITDA growth amid strong organic rental revenue increase and rigorous cost management.

kpis.name: Net Rental Income
kpis.explanation: Revenues from rents after deduction of non-recoverable real estate expenses.
kpis.description: Net rental income grew 6.0% at constant perimeter, exceeding indexation by 320 basis points.
kpis.signal: Double-digit organic growth in net rental revenues exceeding indexation.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of rental space currently occupied by tenants.
kpis.description: Occupancy rate reached 96.2%, up 50 basis points year-over-year, reflecting effective asset management.
kpis.signal: Record occupancy rate reflecting strong tenant demand and effective asset management.

kpis.name: Rent Collection Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of invoiced rents actually collected.
kpis.description: Rent collection rate stands at 97.7%, up 120 basis points year-over-year, demonstrating tenant strength.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in cash-flow quality reflecting strong tenant base creditworthiness.

kpis.name: Tenant Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Progression of tenant sales revenue in shopping centers.
kpis.description: Tenant sales increased 3.9%, excluding disposals/acquisitions and Turkey, with traffic up 2%.
kpis.signal: Tenant sales growth indicating strong shopping center traffic and retail performance.

kpis.name: Portfolio Value Growth
kpis.explanation: Progression of market value of held real estate assets.
kpis.description: Portfolio value increased 2% over six months at constant perimeter, at 19.874 billion euros.
kpis.signal: Recovery in asset values at constant perimeter reflecting improved market conditions.

kpis.name: Net Debt/EBITDA Ratio
kpis.explanation: Measures indebtedness relative to repayment capacity.
kpis.description: Net Debt/EBITDA ratio stands at 7.3x, a historically low level, with average debt cost at 1.6%.
kpis.signal: Historically low leverage ratio providing significant financial capacity for growth investments.

kpis.name: EPRA NTA per Share
kpis.explanation: Net asset value per share according to EPRA standards.
kpis.description: EPRA NTA per share stands at 31.4 EUR, up 4.3% over six months.
kpis.signal: Shareholder value creation over six months demonstrating solid NAV per share growth.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 declared fiscal years by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 0.95 EUR last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 3 declared fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.529 billion EUR last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 3 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 40.7% last year.

ai_positioning.summary: Klépierre does not mention any strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in its recent financial disclosures.
evidence: No mention of AI in the earnings release
No reference to predictive analytics tools or automated asset management
Absence of AI use cases in lease management or traffic optimization
